svg.title: Cingulum bundle naming comparison across TRACULA/MGH_HCP and AFQ/ICBM-DTI-81
svg.desc: Diagram showing the same dorsal-ventral anatomical split of the cingulum bundle labeled differently by two atlas schemes, plus the three-part anterior-posterior division used by XTRACT and Bullock 2022.
svg.text: Dorsal / ventral split of the cingulum bundle
Same boundary, two label sets — no third tract, no spatial gap
XTRACT / Bullock 2022 split by course around the corpus callosum, not dorsal/ventral
